name: @cognovamx/mx-inspector
description: MX Inspector CLI — walks any object type (PDF, raster image, SVG, HTML, markdown, shell, sidecar) and reports the MX metadata it carries. PDFs are classified MX Compatible / EAA Tagged Only / Plain; other carriers are classified mx / plain with their extracted fields. Emits markdown or JSON, exits non-zero when anything is below the configured minimum tier. The standalone distribution of the same detect-classify core that runs the public inspector at https://mx.allabout.network/tools/mx-inspector.html.
author: Tom Cranstoun (CogNovaMX, trading name of Digital Domain Technologies Ltd)
